IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-1105 Newark, OH** is the outlier that'll make you look twice—one call at Sargent clocks in at **$683.00/hr**, working 4-10s, 2-8s, and eight-hour Sunday shifts. That's specialty industrial work, but the board's thin at 10 calls across 88 hands, so it moves fast if you're qualified.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is calling—36 calls for just 44 hands means Book 1 is practically cleared. Northern Powerline Constructors is hiring Inside Wiremen at **$57.44/hr** for JBER runway airfield lighting and cable pulling, with outside linemen pulling **$76.90/hr** on underground feeder rebuilds. Alaska premium is real, and they need bodies.

**LU-545 St. Joseph, MO** has nine solid calls and a short book of 73. Enerfab's Turney Energy Center is stacked—24 Inside JW slots at **$68.51/hr** flat on the check, straight cash for long-term industrial work. No games, no incentives buried in fine print.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is the big board—108 calls, 915 hands waiting. Miller Electrical and Inglett & Stubbs are both running QTS Fayetteville data center work at **$42/hr**, 4-10s and a single 8 on Monday-Friday, 6:30 a.m. starts. Volume play, stable schedule, deep bench.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** has 70 calls on 342 hands for Port Washington Data Center. Gurtz and Cupertino Electric are both offering **JW wage plus $10/hr increase** on 58–60 hour weeks—that's real premium for consistent facility work in the upper Midwest.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** punches above its weight with 18 calls and only 30 hands. Rosendin and Mass Electric are landing Meta and Project Miner work at **$50–$55/hr**, all OT double time, with that tight board meaning faster placement.

Data center build-out is eating the board—every major local is bleeding hands into power-and-cooling infrastructure. If you're chasing long-term stability and OT, follow the megaproject contractors, not the regional name trades.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with 31 calls hunting 50 hands — the deepest board in play today. MJ Electric's lattice tower work in Ft. Wayne is **$56.66/hr** with **$100/day per diem plus room/camper site rent or $175 without**, and they're stacking 4-hand calls on transmission tech and straight journeyman positions. P&G Power's hitting **$67.18/hr** on a URD/distribution job in Goshen with clean-driving-record screeners — that's the high single call on the board. Transmission lattice experience is the key unlock here.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** has 6 calls, 74 hands, and both Cache Valley and Rosendin running the Llano data-center push at **$52.30/hr** across 20-hand gangs. Double-time OT on the Cache Valley calls (58/58/50 structure), straight DT on Rosendin's crew. This is volume play — nearly 40 hands between those two alone.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** sits at 22 calls, 56 hands with Service Electric, Pierce Powerline, and Fairway Electric working metro distribution and transmission. **$46.8–$49.02/hr** range, **$125–$150/day per diem**, and 4-10 or 5-10 schedules. Fairway onboards 10/8/26, Service's moving Bainbridge soon — this is SPP and core work, tight book depth.

**LU-245 Toledo, OH** owns 9 calls, 25 hands, both JW Didado and MJ Electric running transmission at **$56.66/hr** with **$100–$225/day per diem**. Six-twelves and 345kv lattice builds — CDL-A manual required, room/campsite rent factored into the package. High-hour, specialty play.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is 15 calls, 43 hands, Parsons Electric dominating the Polaris Forge data-center project at **$44.80/hr** with **$100/day incentive M–F, $150 Sat/Sun (non-taxed)** and a 100+ mile radius. Eighteen Inside journeymen, 6-10 schedule. Data center work is pulling hands north and west hard right now.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is the board to watch today — 6 calls, 41 hands needed, and the work is solid fab and maintenance. Graham's got a Cenovus gig with **PD 5/hr pyramiding incentive** for pipefitters (must be current in DISA). Gem's running two separate calls: a Fab Shop combo welder slot and an 8-hand BDO operation on 7-10s for pipefitters. Nooter's Cenovus fab work offers **PD 125/day incentive pay** for pipefitters willing to get current in DISA. This is steady fab-and-maintenance velocity with real per diem meat on the bone — the kind of work that sticks around.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 5 calls and ~26 hands in the pipeline, heavy on fab and specialty welding. US Eng. Metalworks needs 4 fitters and 4 welders with stainless experience; Power Source is pulling combo welders with rigging certs for JM Shafer at Fort Lupton. Trautman and Shreve split day and swing shifts on MIG/TIG work. Murphy's flexential data center play in Centennial is a single-welder SMAW job on 4/10s plus an 8 Monday-Friday — tight spec but solid.

**LU-213 St John, NB** is lean but urgent: 3 calls, 5 hands. Stuart Olson and CAM are both pulling F3/F4 and F5/F6 welders for Irving Oil Refinery turnarounds starting ASAP on 6x10 schedules, with **shutdown incentives** in the mix. One more call for a journeyman pipefitter at LNG Lorneville on 4x10s-plus. This is refinery work — hot, certified-only play.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** has minimal board depth (1 call, 2 hands) but PMI's Fort Meade VA Hospital project needs a med-gas plumber with OSHA 10 at **PD $100/day for days worked**. Background-check-gated but stable.

The work is chasing certifications and fab shops — DISA current, stainless TIG, F-number certs. Industrial maintenance and refinery shutdowns are driving the depth.
